text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Phew... That parade wasn't exactly elegant...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Opera O is so fast and strong... Not to
mention
that hill...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
It felt so much steeper than usual... My
legs felt
paralyzed from the pressure...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
So this is a long-distance G1 race... This
is the
spring Tenno Sho...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Well done to you, Doto. Your
performance as my
guide was
satisfactory.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
But you mustn't forget, should you wish
to run by
my side, this year's repertoire
will be replete with
arduous paths, much
like in today's experience.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Yes, I u-understand... I promise to be
more
diligent next time!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
She solemnly swears to improve herself.
Keeping
up with Т.М. Опера О on the
road ahead won't be
an easy feat.
